title: Certification of the 2025 Statewide Special Election
description:
Today, December 2, Registrar of Voters Bob Page certified the Orange County results of the 2025 Statewide Special Election. Please watch this video for a special message from Bob.  
 
In summary:
 
• Total voter turnout for the Statewide Special Election was 52.3 percent. Of the 999,918 ballots cast by Orange County voters and counted, 88.2 percent cast a Vote-By-Mail ballot, and 11.8 percent cast an in-person ballot at Vote Centers. For more information on these election results, visit ocvote.gov/results.

• Thank you to the approximately 700 community members who worked diligently throughout this election to support voters in our Vote Centers and in the field.

• Thank you to our Registrar of Voters operational and administrative staff for working behind the scenes to keep the election running smoothly.

• Tomorrow (Dec. 3), the Statement of Votes will be submitted to the Secretary of State. To view statewide results for the 2025 Statewide Special Election, visit electionresults.sos.ca.gov.
 
#OCVotes #VoteEasyVoteSecure #EveryVoteCounts #SpecialElection2025
